_readme: The only file you edit. Delete these _readme keys once you have filled it in.
actuals   : figures read off the annual report. Period labels must match the
Screener columns exactly (Mar-24). Anything here wins over Screener.
citations : required for every line in actuals. source is a path inside the
knowledge base; page is the printed page number.
drivers   : a number, or a list with one entry per forecast year. Rates are
options   : dep_basis net_block | sales; avg_years is the trailing window used
for any driver neither assumptions.json nor this file sets.

actuals._readme: Trade payables are the one Screener never carries - always pull them.

capex.quote: Additions to property, plant and equipment

drivers._readme: Anything omitted comes from assumptions.json, then from the trailing historical average.
